guideNote: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it (sources 5 and 6). Every guide below is this entry's own words and cites its sources by number (see data/sources.json, read 20 Nov 2026). Where sources disagree, both versions are shown and the trophy is flagged disputed. Where no source has a verified method, the trophy is flagged unconfirmed and no method is invented.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned; there is no separate task for it. Plan around A Long Road (100% completion), which is the long pole — everything else falls out of the story, the stranger questlines and the cleanup stages. No online play is needed: all 55 trophies are offline and single-player.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum unlocks automatically.
Expect A Long Road (100% completion) to be the last one you earn.
One playthrough is enough — there is no New Game+ and no mission replay, so keep manual saves.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1; it pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 1; it pops when you complete the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Complete Chapter 1.
It unlocks as Chapter 2 begins.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 2; it pops when the first Chapter 3 mission, Welcome to Vice City, is complete.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Complete Chapter 2.
It unlocks as Chapter 3 begins.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 3; it pops after the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Complete Chapter 3.
It unlocks early in Chapter 4, after Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish Chapter 4; it pops after the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Complete Chapter 4.
It unlocks after the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the final mission and the story ends — the trophy pops. DISPUTED WORDING: some lists word this as finishing Chapter 5, while the mission-by-mission guide ties it to the final mission itself; either way, the unlock is the same — finish the story. Do not chase a separate Chapter 5 task that the description does not name.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Play the story to its final mission and complete it.
The trophy pops when the story ends; free-roam continues after it.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run; it pops at the mission's end and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Reach Chapter 2 and play the main mission Breakfast Run.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist; it pops at the mission's end and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Reach Chapter 3 and play the main mission The Cartel Heist.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.where: Story — Chapter 3, mission The Cartel Heist

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play; it pops at the mission's end and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Reach Chapter 4 and play the main mission Child's Play.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners; it pops at the mission's end and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Reach Chapter 4 and play the main mission Headliners.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown; it pops at the mission's end and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Reach Chapter 4 and play the main mission VCIA Takedown.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory; it pops at the mission's end and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Reach Chapter 5 and play the main mission Operation Savage Glory.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.where: Story — Chapter 5, mission Operation Savage Glory

trophies.guide: The long one: reach 100% on the in-game checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, unlocked after the story). The checklist is lenient — closer to 60% true completion — and nothing on it is missable, so do it after the story in free-roam. It needs: 100 optional tasks; every robbery (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loans, 8 bank vaults); 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned; 100 of 255 animals studied; 15 of 18 card sets; 100 WAiNK scans; 33 underwater discoveries; 70 of 80 challenges; 300 of 397 stunts; 42 of 42 shooting-range golds; 42 of 42 drone time trials; 15 of 15 Bret target decks; plus fencing totals ($100k narcotics, $100k jewelry, $250k marked bills, $200k vehicles). Progress made during the story already counts.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story first — the checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Work the robberies to completion: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loans, 8 bank vaults.
Scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles (WAiNK app) and study 100 of 255 animals (binoculars).
Finish 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos.
Earn 42 of 42 shooting-range golds, 42 of 42 drone time trials, 300 of 397 stunts and 70 of 80 challenges.
Complete 100 optional tasks and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks; hit the fencing totals.
The trophy pops when the checklist reads 100%.

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps (ramps), 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights (between buildings) and 25 base jumps (parachute). Mix them however you like — under-the-bridge flights are the quickest. For 100% you need 300. Track progress by region in Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, where each stunt has a unique name and stays marked once done.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Do any 250 stunts across the four kinds; under-the-bridge flights are the fastest.
Track by region in Progress > Activities > Stunts and on the map (Exploration > Stunt Spots).
Performing a stunt once counts as completed; the map-icon challenges are not required.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check Progress > Activities to see which types you have done; most come naturally from the story and the other trophies, so do not chase this one early.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open Progress > Activities to see which of the 9 types you still need.
Do one of each: fish, hunt, golf, shoot a range, play pool, score a basketball hoop, play a video game, win a race, perform a stunt.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 range locations. The gold medals are not very hard, and range sessions also level your Focus stat, which helps Gunslinger. All 42 are needed for 100% too.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit the 12 Shooting Range locations.
Earn a gold medal in each of the 42 challenges.
Ranges also raise your Focus level — useful for Gunslinger.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations — 42 drone races / time trials in total. All 42 are needed for 100% as well, so this is not a side quest you can skip.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun locations on the map.
Win a drone race at each location (42 races in total).

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations; 30 wins are needed for 100%. Any mix of race types counts, so pick the ones you are fastest at.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Win 20 different races across the 40 unique race locations.
Any race type counts; 30 wins are needed for 100%.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (meet Cal), Cal texts you a fishing location marked with a purple icon on the map, west of Key Lento. Do the challenge there. It stays available after the story, but it is on the watch list because it is tied to a story contact — do it when it appears.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: After Chapter 1, Feng Shui, wait for Cal's text.
Go to the purple fishing marker west of Key Lento.
Beat Cal in the fishing challenge.
trophies.where: West of Key Lento (after Ch 1, Feng Shui)

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game (called Video Games in-game). There are 4: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck, found at arcade machines around the world. To complete a game, finish all of its levels at least once — you do not need to beat every challenge. Pick whichever you like best.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Pick one of the 4 video games (3 on the home TV, 1 at arcade machines).
Finish all of its levels at least once; challenges are optional.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is Lucia-only: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then she texts her home address, marking the questline in Belville. Complete her 5 quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (join the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the Cellerica van), Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse). All of it is still available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: In Chapter 3, as Lucia, take Andy's call and go to her address in Belville.
Complete her 5 quests, ending with Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's questline is marked in Chapter 1; a while after the mission Island Dreams (work for Kenton) he calls you and is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He offers sets of treasure-diving quests (shipwrecks): he marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map, you find the underwater treasures with the metal detector and bring them back. After the first set he calls you back for more — 7 shipwrecks in total. Kenton goes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3 (as Jason; calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds it up). Still available after the story. Track it in Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: After Chapter 1, Island Dreams, take Kenton's call (green KR icon, Key Lento).
Dive his marked shipwrecks (7 total) and bring the treasures back.
Return when he calls for the next set; the final mission pops the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his 5 quests — Thrillbillies (check out the mud club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler), Hometown Heroes. All of it is still available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: After Chapter 2, Coffee Break, go to Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete Billy's 5 quests, ending with Hometown Heroes.
trophies.where: Thrillbilly Mudclub, Kelly County — after Ch 2

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying stranger mission strands. Only certain questlines count toward this trophy — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count, so do not grind those for it. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk (Skunk Ape: search for the Skunk Ape, search for tree effigies, help Kirk find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (McKittrick Farm, collect chemicals, check on Kyle), Yago (street race, mentor Yago, race against Yago, back up Yago) and Pilot Pete (recover Pete's plane, deliver packages). The guides note there are more strangers yet to be discovered. All strands remain available after the story; track the count in the trophy list.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Do 8 qualifying stranger strands — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count.
Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy.
Check the count in the trophy list; everything is still available after the story.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (steal the Zorrusso for Randy) — that mission also unlocks the Key Cloner for breaking into high-end sports cars. Randy then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon). Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check them against the list, then drive each one back; delivering in good condition pays more. Cars are frequent in east Vice City at Vice Beach / Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or driving around. Still available after the story. Track the list in Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: After Chapter 3, Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, take Randy's list (16 sports cars).
Scan sports cars with WAiNK to check them against the list.
Deliver each one to Randy's garage in west Vice City, in good condition.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's questline is marked after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty and is Jason-only. Purple markers show Synthetic Labs in Vice City; go to the labs and destroy them (quest Take Out Kitty Litter). After destroying enough labs, Tyrone gives his second quest, Spin On This (shut down the labs), which pops the trophy. All of it is still available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: After Chapter 3, Here, Kitty Kitty, as Jason, destroy the marked Synthetic Labs (Take Out Kitty Litter).
Take Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This, and shut down the labs.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 meditation spots at 10 locations. You can meditate with both Lucia and Jason at each spot, which counts as +2 at the same location. Track it in Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY: the first meditation, at Jason's house, can only be done in Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, then walks to the balcony; follow her and choose Accept. It raises the counter +1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest, so it is still unclear whether it is required for the trophy — do it anyway, it costs nothing. The last meditation needs both characters playable (after Chapter 2, Coffee Break). For 100% only 15 of 18 meditations are needed.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: CHAPTER 1 ONLY: after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and Accept the meditation.
Meditate at all 18 spots (10 locations); doing a spot with both characters counts +2.
Track in Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations; the last spot needs both characters (after Ch 2, Coffee Break).

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's questline is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break; playing as Jason you get a text marking Veteran Hunted (meet Bret) in Lummox County — Lucia cannot receive the message, this line is Jason-only. Bret gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 (retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker); hunt the animals he marks with purple icons and bring them to him. DISPUTED: which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed by the guides — complete his Target Decks (15 total, all needed for 100%) and it comes along the way. Track them in Map > Activities > Target Deck.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: After Chapter 2, Coffee Break, as Jason, take Bret's text (Veteran Hunted, Lummox County).
Hunt the animals Bret marks and bring them to him; use the Killtelligence SM-69.
Complete his 15 Target Decks; the exact unlocking animal is still being confirmed.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in the game and 15 are needed for 100%, so this pops early on the collectible path. Cards are found across Leonida — use the map's Exploration filter to track sets and which cards you still need.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Collect cards across Leonida; track sets on the map (Exploration filter).
Complete any 3 full sets (15 of 18 are needed for 100%).

trophies.guide: WAiNK-scan 100 locations. Scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures with the WAiNK app (hold to scan): 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus Flusher Tags. Any 100 count — there are more than 100 in the world — so scan whatever you pass. It also feeds the 100% checklist (100 scans).
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the WAiNK app and scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and Flusher Tags.
Any 100 scans count; scan whatever you pass while exploring.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. For 100% you need 70, so this pops on the way there. Track them in Progress > Challenges (the checkmark at the bottom right shows completed ones). Most complete naturally while working on other trophies; keep it for late in the run, then pick the easiest and quickest of the ones you have left.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Work the other trophies; most challenges complete naturally.
Track in Progress > Challenges and pick the easiest remaining ones to reach 50 (70 for 100%).

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. The earliest you can do it is after Chapter 2 (Coffee Break), when you can free-roam as Jason and Lucia together — call your partner and cause carnage until you reach 4 stars, then escape the red heat zone. A fast sports motorcycle cutting through traffic works; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the easy route, because cops struggle to follow on train tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. It also pops naturally during Chapter 4's That's Where The Money Is… and the bank vault robberies, which always trigger 4-star wanted levels.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: After Chapter 2 (Coffee Break), call your partner and reach a 4-star wanted level.
Escape the red heat zone — try the train tunnel north of Ambrosia, Kelly County.
It also pops naturally during the bank vault robberies.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Only after Chapter 2 (Coffee Break), when you can switch between both characters: call your partner, then loot 3 robbery targets (green icons) while staying wanted the whole time — keep the flashing wanted level, do not let it clear. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs (Ammu-Nation) and healing (Zombix/Adrenaline). A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Chapter 3, Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs): rob a few items in each, go into the back room and break the safe with sticky bombs. The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after the 3rd shop; if it does not pop, hit a 4th shop and keep going. If you leave the first store before police arrive, you may need a 4th store.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: After Chapter 2 (Coffee Break), call your partner and gear up (vest, sticky bombs, healing).
Loot 3 shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time (north Vice City jewelry stores work well).
Break the back-room safe in each; wait ~30 s after the 3rd shop — hit a 4th if it does not pop.
trophies.where: North Vice City jewelry stores (after Ch 3)

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. With the WAiNK app (hold to open it instantly), look at vehicles and hold to scan them — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic. GTA VI has 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes); for 100% you need 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this pops automatically. Track discovered vehicles in Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Open the WAiNK app and scan vehicles as you pass them (a busy road is fastest).
Scanning is enough — no need to drive them; 200 of 277 base models are needed for 100%.
Track in Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.where: Any busy road — scan passing traffic

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it while aiming a firearm — it slows time and highlights vulnerable spots, draining the purple focus bar, which only lasts a few seconds. Buff focus first (food/drinks, washing your face or showering at home, Adrenaline to extend it) and wear body armor (Ammu-Nation) so you can step out of cover. Line up 5 enemies — gang members at Gang Operations are best — and drop them fast with an assault rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to count soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus); level it with shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — you will likely reach level 4 naturally, and the trophy may pop on its own.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Buff focus (food, shower, Adrenaline) and wear body armor.
Activate Combat Focus while aiming and drop 5 gang enemies fast with an assault rifle.
Soldiers, police and civilians do not seem to count; level Focus to 4 for a longer window.
trophies.where: Gang Operations — 5 enemies, one Combat Focus

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal — one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not the planes parked on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head straight to the plane, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to enter, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport. The pop is slightly delayed. You can also enter on foot through the airport terminal, but the airfield route is faster.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA and reach a large plane docked at terminals E3/E4 (boarding bridge).
Enter via the stairs, get to the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip and take off.
Fly at least 1 km from the airport; the pop is slightly delayed.

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (Rhino) and use it in combat. Tanks stand at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate — or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance — enter a tank and shoot enemies until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station (Mariana County, south-west edge of the map).
Enter a tank in the south of the base and shoot enemies until it pops.
trophies.where: Mile Zero Air Station, Mariana County

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3, Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun (silent lockpick) and jewelry store robberies, marked automatically with a green icon on unfogged map areas. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (do not kick the door — that triggers the alarm), find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, and destroy the security footage and disable the alarm in the back room. The trophy pops shortly after you leave. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Finish Chapter 3, Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (unlocks the Snap Gun).
Enter a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun — never kick the door.
Loot the safe with the code note, destroy the footage, disable the alarm, then leave.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) — it teaches vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open (bring your partner to carry a bag — you cannot carry all the cash alone). After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (after his earlier quests: 2 Payday Loans) to mark vans with purple icons. Each vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles. There are 8 large bank jobs total; all 8 are needed for 100%, and each pays up to $205,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Finish Chapter 4, That's Where The Money Is… (first vault robbery, taught in-mission).
Pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips to mark vans (purple icons).
Rob any 5 vaults (8 total; all 8 needed for 100%) and escape each 4-star wanted level.
trophies.where: Banks — after Ch 4, That's Where The Money Is…

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically from the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… — robbing a bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck. Earlier method: find armored trucks driving near banks in Vice City, block one, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it, then escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray). Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests (Yasmani unlocks as a fence from Chapter 3, Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs). All 8 large bank jobs are needed for 100%, so this comes automatically.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Do the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… — the vault robbery counts.
Earlier option: sticky-bomb an armored truck near a bank, then escape the heat radius.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. Best done with a plane: fly over every fogged area until the entire map is visible. Start early and top it up as you travel, so the last pass is short.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Get a plane and fly over every fogged (black) area of the map.
Keep topping it up as you travel; the trophy pops when the map is fully visible.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Only 1 operation per gang is needed for the trophy (all 39 are needed for 100%). Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them; many are also marked automatically from story progress. Track per gang in Progress > Gangs — it shows how many of each gang's operations you have robbed.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Rob one Illegal Operation for each of the 9 gangs (yellow map icons).
Track per gang in Progress > Gangs; all 39 are needed for 100%.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. DISPUTED: PowerPyx's method is to go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and buy an Apple Martini, then drink it standing next to the bar. KeenGamer still lists the exact trigger as being confirmed — so treat the rooftop bar as the lead, and if it does not pop, try other Ocean Beach bars and viewpoints. Do not treat either version as settled.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar (Ocean Beach) and buy an Apple Martini.
Drink it standing next to the bar; if it does not pop, try other Ocean Beach bars.
trophies.where: Ocean View Rooftop Bar, Ocean Beach

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. DISPUTED: PowerPyx's method is to steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City — you need the Key Cloner (Chapter 3, Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS) — hack into the car, drive forward straight through the window; the pop is slightly delayed and only works with that blue Banshee (a GTA III easter egg), not any other car. KeenGamer still lists the exact method as unconfirmed, so if the Banshee does not pop it, the trigger may be a different showroom or car.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Get the Key Cloner (Chapter 3, Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS).
Steal the blue Banshee from the south Vice City showroom and drive it through the window.
trophies.where: South Vice City showroom — blue Banshee

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, a Gang Operation in Port Gellhorn: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs — buy them at Ammu-Nation first). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. You visit during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling; if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later and you can grab the rest then — not missable, and you do not need all 3 in one go.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
steps: Go to Kingpin Bowling, Port Gellhorn (Chapter 2, Hit Kingpin Bowling).
Take the luxury watch (south-east office), the Gutterball shotgun (north-east corner) and the safe (sticky bombs).
Escape the police — the trophy pops after the escape, not on the third item.

trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Available after Chapter 2 (Coffee Break), when you can switch between both characters. Check strength in Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). Work out at fitness clubs — buy a membership and filter Map > Activities (dumbbell icon) for clubs all over Vice City. Always go together with both characters (call your partner): while you actively work out with one, the other automatically completes their training, so you make double progress. You can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: After Chapter 2 (Coffee Break), buy a fitness club membership.
Work out with both characters together (call your partner) so both train at once.
Reach maximum Strength on both Jason and Lucia at the same time.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on criminal-profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) — a demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. Actions range from clean and stealthy (Professional: finishing objectives and robberies stealthily, destroying evidence, clean escapes) to incapacitating without killing (Hardened) to killing (Violent, Psycho) to permanent (Irredeemable — avoid it; cops get more aggressive and it cannot be undone). It comes passively from robberies and encounters, so do not farm it early; if anything is left at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car. Check the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications).
Play normally — robberies and encounters count toward the 500.
If anything is left at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops (avoid Irredeemable).

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no guide has a verified method for this trophy yet. PowerPyx's current belief is that it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, possibly robbing it again later in a specific manner (the store is in Vice City, Little Cuba). KeenGamer lists the unlock method as unconfirmed. Do not follow an unverified method as fact — this guide will be updated when a source confirms it, and the trophy is flagged unconfirmed in the tracker until then.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: No verified method exists yet — do not chase a rumour.
Current belief (unconfirmed): related to the Payday Loans store in Vice City, Little Cuba.
Check back when a guide confirms the trigger.
trophies.where: UNCONFIRMED — believed: Payday Loans, Little Cuba

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? DISPUTED: PowerPyx's method is to complete the UFO easter egg — at night after 2AM, go solo to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County; sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside (if it is not there, drive away and come back). Follow the path into the woods from the car to find the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky); approach it, it drops an abducted woman — talk to her, offer to help, and return to her car at the roadside. The spawn is slightly random, not guaranteed. KeenGamer still lists the method as unconfirmed, so treat the UFO as the lead, not a certainty.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: After 2AM, go solo to the road north-west of Starlet Motel, Kelly County.
Look for the blinking car at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and return.
Follow the path into the woods to the UFO, approach it, help the woman it drops, and return to her car.
trophies.where: North-west of Starlet Motel, Kelly County — after 2AM

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. DISPUTED: PowerPyx's method is to ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with a melee attack within 60 seconds — do it in crowded areas like Vice City or Ocean Beach. KeenGamer says the precise method is still being confirmed, so if the bike kicks do not pop it, the trigger may need a different vehicle or timing.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Ride any bike into a crowded area (Vice City or Ocean Beach).
Kick 10 pedestrians with melee attacks within 60 seconds.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish Chapter 3, Credit Check (meet Raul's Crew) — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies, not in one go. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery (unlocked after Chapter 4, That's Where The Money Is…). It also counts toward the 100% checklist ($250,000 marked bills fenced).
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Finish Chapter 3, Credit Check (unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer).
Rob banks and Payday Loans; bring marked bills to a fence (Yasmani pays most).
$250,000 cumulative; bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest, as they are the most expensive. Shop counts: 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios, 15 electronics stores. It accumulates across the whole game, so buy gear as you go rather than saving it all for the end.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend $100,000 total across any shops.
Fastest: guns, car mods and tattoos.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 purchasable garage properties (there are 4 more story garages; only the 8 bought ones count). Total cost $160,000. Garages become available after Chapter 2, Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses) — the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone. Buy them through the app; fund it with robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4. You need the garages anyway for On the Spot (registering vehicles).
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: After Chapter 2, Daily Driver, open the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 total).
Garages also add the parking spots On the Spot needs.
trophies.where: Vice City Real Estate app — after Ch 2

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after Chapter 2, Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location anywhere. You need enough garages first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; in his garage choose Respray then Register. He only accepts vehicles without trackers at first; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money — use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: After Chapter 2, Moses, open the Scooter Bros app.
Buy garages first (Little Boxes) so you have parking spots.
Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, Respray then Register — 10 total.
